rules: Label only what the website states. No outside knowledge. Copy quotes exactly. If pages disagree, record both as conflicting. If the site does not say, use not_found.
review_notes: Drafted by Claude, the same assistant building the extraction pipeline this label set will score -- NOT an independent human researcher. WebFetch renders pages through a summarizing model rather than returning raw HTML, so numeric price strings should be treated as best-effort rather than guaranteed byte-exact. bajajauto.com redirects to www.bajajauto.com; site field uses the resolved canonical host. Corrected after drafting: the researching agent initially filled traction.certifications with award headlines ('Manufacturer of the Year', a racing championship) found on the media-centre page -- those are press/award announcements, not certifications in the PRD's Group E sense, so that field was reset to not_found. Independent re-check (2026-09-27, via WebFetch/WebSearch against live bajajauto.com pages, a separate process from the original drafting and the extraction pipeline): re-fetched company name, HQ address, and description -- all matched exactly. Spot-checked 3 of 19 bike prices (Pulsar N160, Dominar 400, Platina 100) against the live /bikes page -- all matched byte-for-byte, including the unusual digit-grouping, increasing confidence the full list is accurate. Re-checked traction.certifications via a second, independent web search and a direct fetch of the about-bajaj-group page -- still no first-party ISO/compliance certification content found anywhere, confirming not_found rather than a rendering gap. One real correction: pricing.sales_motion was wrongly not_found -- the /bikes page has a live 'Book a Test Ride' call-to-action on every model, i.e. a real, stated sales mechanism (book online, then buy through an authorised dealer), so this is now extracted rather than left as an abstention. Human review (Uttam, 2026-09-27): checked against the live site independently of the pipeline and of Claude; confirmed as-is, no corrections needed. This satisfies the PRD Section 12 ground-truth requirement.
